email_templates.subject: ActTrident 90-day Evaluation Program for {{company_name}} ({{city}})
email_templates.body_example:
Hello {{recipient_name}},

I am reaching out from ActTrident (https://acttrident.ai/). We specialize in enterprise endpoint protection and browser workspace security designed specifically to safeguard distributed workstations and modern cloud workflows.

We noticed {{company_name}}'s growing technical operations in {{city}} and your team's deployment of managed laptops. Companies in the {{industry}} sector often require rigorous security controls around client deliverables and web-based development environments.

ActTrident provides lightweight, non-intrusive protection for company laptops. It isolates sensitive browser sessions, safeguards corporate accounts, and ensures devices accessing your business services maintain verified security compliance.

We would welcome the opportunity to share a concise 15-minute product overview tailored to your environment.

For eligible companies managing at least five company laptops, we are currently offering a proposed 90-day free product evaluation. This allows your team to experience ActTrident's capabilities in your actual environment with full technical support and zero obligation.

Would you be open to a brief 15-minute introductory call next Tuesday or Wednesday to discuss whether this evaluation program is a fit for your team?

Best regards,
Business Development Team | ActTrident
https://acttrident.ai/ | outreach@acttrident.ai
